text: Hospital da Luz is one of Luz Saúde's main brands: the group's 2024 annual report records the 2016 consolidation of its business areas into three main brands, Hospital da Luz (hospitals and clinics) among them.
short: Hospital da Luz is a Luz Saúde brand.

source.name: Luz Saúde, S.A. Annual Report 2024 (English), Relatório de Contas
source.quote: 2016 Consolidation of business areas into three main brands: Hospital da Luz (hospitals and clinics), Hospital do Mar Specialized Care and Casas da Cidade Senior Residences.
